full_text_en:
Multistack International Co., Ltd. v. Shenzhen Fuwei Cooling & Heating Equipment Co., Ltd. — dispute over infringement of invention patent

Plaintiff: Multistack International Co., Ltd., domiciled at Ringwood, Victoria, Australia.

Legal Representative: Richmond Smith, Executive Chairman.

Agent ad litem: Li Zhige, Legal Counsel of Hong Kong Jiefeng Sunon Enterprise Co., Ltd.

Agent ad litem: Peng Qingzheng, lawyer of Guangzhou International Economic and Trade Law Firm.

Defendant: Shenzhen Fuwei Cooling & Heating Equipment Co., Ltd.

Legal Representative: Lin Qizheng, Chairman of the Board.

Agent ad litem: Zhang Xuelin, lawyer of Shenzhen Tianyuan Law Firm.

Agent ad litem: Sai Ji, staff member of the Legal Services Department of Shenzhen Tianping Industrial Company.

The plaintiff, Multistack International Co., Ltd., filed an action with the Shenzhen Intermediate People's Court of Guangdong Province against the defendant, Shenzhen Fuwei Cooling & Heating Equipment Co., Ltd., concerning a dispute over infringement of invention patent.

Plaintiff's Allegations: On August 15, 1985, the inventor Ronald David Conry filed an invention patent application, Application No. 85106145, for a combined refrigeration system with the Patent Office of the People's Republic of China. On January 8, 1992, the plaintiff lawfully acquired the ownership of the said invention patent. The plaintiff's combined refrigeration system invention patent has been certified by the American Society of Mechanical Engineers (A.S.M.E.) and the Electrical Testing Laboratories (E.T.L.), and has been applied for patent in 43 countries. Within the territory of China, only Panyu Sunon Cooling & Heating Equipment Co., Ltd. has obtained a license to use it. However, since the end of 1992, the plaintiff discovered that the defendant, without permission, had illegally used the said invention patent to manufacture and sell products within the territory of China. The plaintiff submitted the products manufactured and sold by the defendant to the Shenzhen Bureau of Technical Supervision and the Shenzhen Product Quality Supervision and Inspection Institute for appraisal, which confirmed that the technical structural features of the defendant's manufactured products were similar to those of the plaintiff's invention patent. The plaintiff believes that, in accordance with the provisions of Article 60 of the Patent Law of the PRC, the defendant's actions have constituted a serious infringement of the plaintiff's combined refrigeration system invention patent and have caused adverse effects. Pursuant to Article 60 of the Patent Law and Article 20 of the Civil Procedure Law of the PRC, the plaintiff brings this action to safeguard its lawful rights and interests.

The defendant, Shenzhen Fuwei Cooling & Heating Equipment Co., Ltd., did not submit a defense.

Facts Found by the Shenzhen Intermediate People's Court upon Trial: On August 15, 1985, Ronald David Conry, the inventor of the DZW-110 unit combination (modular) chiller technology, filed an invention patent application, Application No. 85106145, with the Chinese Patent Office. On January 8, 1992, the plaintiff lawfully acquired the patent right for the said invention. Without the permission of the plaintiff, the defendant, Shenzhen Fuwei Cooling & Heating Equipment Co., Ltd., since early 1993, has unauthorizedly manufactured and sold DZW-110 unit combination (modular) chillers. The products manufactured and sold by the defendant possess the essential technical features for which the plaintiff's patented product seeks protection.

Opinion of the Court: Article 11, paragraph 1 of the Patent Law provides that, after the grant of a patent right, except where otherwise provided by law, no entity or individual may, without the permission of the patentee, manufacture, use, or sell the patented product for production and business purposes. After the plaintiff, Multistack International Co., Ltd., obtained the patent right for the DZW-110 unit combination (modular) chiller, the defendant, Shenzhen Fuwei Cooling & Heating Equipment Co., Ltd., without the plaintiff's permission, manufactured and sold the patented product for production and business purposes, thereby constituting patent infringement. In accordance with the provisions of Article 85 of the Civil Procedure Law of the PRC, upon mediation by this court, and on the basis of clear facts and a clear distinction between right and wrong, on June 7, 1994, the parties voluntarily reached the following agreement:

1. The defendant shall cease the manufacture and sale of DZW-110 unit combination (modular) chillers and other patent infringing activities.
2. The defendant agrees to compensate the plaintiff for losses in the amount of RMB 226,990.
